_comment: Does the bot actually open a link and read it? The page is served from a local HTTP server and contains a fact that appears nowhere in the prompt, so the answer can only come from reading it. The assertion is the fact and the URL it came from — an answer without the citation would mean the model guessed. The harness's web_fetch refuses a loopback address, so seen live the agent reads it with curl from its shell. What this is not: a browser. No JavaScript runs and nothing is clicked.

steps.say: 이 URL 을 열어서 이번 릴리스의 배포 코드명이 무엇인지 알려줘. 어느 URL 에서 읽었는지도 같이 적어줘. http://127.0.0.1:8899/page.html
그 페이지에 적힌 롤백 윈도우는 몇 분이라고 되어 있어?
